description: Subscapularis blankets the anterior scapula and funnels forward to the lesser tubercle, giving the armpit a firm, hidden wall of rotator-cuff power.
actions: Medially rotates the humerus, sealing the anterior shoulder for strong inward sweeps.
Helps adduct and stabilize the humeral head when the arm is raised.
Forms the anterior wall of the axilla, smoothing transitions from chest to arm.
